capabilities: Insert managed shopping-list blocks from the command palette
Sort managed blocks by checkbox status, store keywords, and item name
Hide block markers in the editor while keeping them in the source
Auto-sort after edits with a configurable debounce delay
extras: Store sorting is oriented to German supermarkets by default (aldi, dm, edeka, lidl, netto, penny, rewe); store keywords are configurable via settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep shopping-list task blocks automatically ordered by status and store, without affecting other checkboxes in the note.
summary: Shopping-list plugin that inserts managed Markdown task blocks and keeps them sorted by checkbox status, configurable store keywords, and item name.
